battle.name: 摩門戰爭
battle.theater: 密蘇里州西北部卡德威爾郡
battle.brief: 一八三八年，密蘇里西北部反摩門暴民與後期聖徒互相攻擊，衝突由八月加拉丁選舉鬥毆升級為九月德威特圍城。十月十日克羅克德河之戰後州長下驅逐令，十月二十九日民兵攻入卡德威爾郡，哈恩磨坊一役十七名後期聖徒死亡。十一月斯密在遠西部投降並被囚。火繩槍只是鄉間遺留的舊獵槍，兩軍用的是燧發步槍。

kit.name: 火繩槍
kit.history: 火繩槍要點火、要瞄、要排隊。方陣把這些弱點變成了整齊的彈幕。

countries: 這場衝突的交戰雙方在法律上都不是國家，而是一個州與一批被它視為非法的居民。州方是密蘇里州：州長利爾本·博格斯以下有州民兵、縣級民兵與自願組成的治安團體，後來由大衛·賴斯·阿奇森、亞歷山大·多尼芬等准將率領的旅投入，州議會在查爾斯·丹寧斯等人推動下另行立法授權；聯邦政府一開始置身事外，直到越境蔓延才由利文沃思堡的通信確認地方當局無法控制局面。後期聖徒一方則是由約瑟·斯密與希律·斯密率領的教會團體，在卡爾郡與戴維斯郡有教區與民兵編制：由喬治·辛克爾上校率領的卡爾郡民兵，以及受州民兵委任、但由教會領袖實際調配的武裝；另有「但以理派」這一支對領袖不滿、拒絕服從的派別，其存在使教會內部的指揮鏈條在開戰前就已出現裂縫。地理上，戰鬥集中在密蘇里州西北角：卡爾郡的德威特與遠西部、戴維斯郡與雷郡的克羅克德河，以及卡德威爾郡的哈恩磨坊。雙方都不是有正規編制的軍隊，而是以民兵、教會武裝與私人武裝拼成的隊伍，這一點決定了整場衝突的性質。
countriesEn: Legally, neither side in this conflict was a state: on one side was the state of Missouri and on the other a body of residents whom that state treated as illegal. The Missouri side comprised the state militia, county militia and volunteer vigilance companies under Governor Lilburn Boggs, and was reinforced by brigades commanded by men such as David Rice Atchison and Alexander Doniphan, with the state legislature pressed by Charles Danforth and others into authorising extraordinary powers; the federal government kept out of it at first, and only the correspondence from Fort Leavenworth showed that the local authorities could not keep control of what was spreading across the border. The Latter-day Saint side was the church organisation itself, led by Joseph Smith and Hyrum Smith, with its own congregations and militia districts in Carroll and Daviess counties: the Carroll county militia under Colonel George Hinkle, and detachments nominally raised by the state militia but in fact handled by the church leadership. There was also a body known as the Danites, a group out of sympathy with the leadership that refused to be directed by it, and its existence had already split the chain of command inside the church before the fighting began. Geographically the fighting was confined to the north-west corner of Missouri: the towns of De Witt and Far West in Carroll county, the Crooked River on the line between Daviess and Ray counties, and Haun's Mill in Caldwell county. Neither side was a regular army: both were patched together from militia, church levies and private arms, and that fact decided the character of the whole conflict.
people: 約瑟·斯密是後期聖徒一方的最高決策者，也是這場衝突的終點。他在德威特圍城前一直主張用議會與法律途徑解決，圍城開始後才同意組建武裝；克羅克德河之役後，十月二十七日州長博格斯發出驅逐令，措辭是必須把摩門人當作敵人、予以驅逐或滅絕，遠西部的人得知後才決定不再抵抗。十一月一日，辛克爾上校奉命出談，條件極為苛刻：交出首領受審、交出全部武器、參與武裝者變賣財產賠償民眾損失並負擔民兵召集費用、開赴戰鬥者一律離州；斯密聽到這些條件後說自己不介意，因為他本就想離開這個該死的州，第二天上午他與其他首領隨民兵營前往遠西部投降。他被關進自由監獄，罪名是叛國、謀殺、縱火、盜竊、搶劫與偽證，一八三九年春轉移途中他逃脫，隨後在伊利諾伊州建立納伏。希律·斯密、賽德尼·里格登、萊曼·懷特、卡萊布·鮑德溫與亞歷山大·麥克雷同樣被囚，其中數人後來在伊利諾伊與愛荷華建立了各自的教會。州方最關鍵的人是利爾本·博格斯州長，他原為副州長，一八三二年傑克遜縣的驅逐中站在暴民一方，上台後對摩門人更為敵視，簽發驅逐令並集結兩千五百名州民兵。多尼芬准將是唯一拒絕執行死刑命令的人：當軍事法庭判令將斯密等人於次日上午在遠西部廣場槍斃時，他回答這是冷血謀殺，拒絕服從，並表示若執行他會追究責任。塞繆爾·博加特率領的民兵是直接動手的一方，他奉阿奇森准將之命巡邏雷郡與卡爾郡之間的無地帶，卻越界進入金德威爾郡解除莫門武裝，把衝突從政治鬥爭變成武裝對峙；哈恩磨坊一役的率隊者是來自利文斯敦郡的托馬斯·詹寧斯中校。
peopleEn: Joseph Smith was the supreme decision maker of the Latter-day Saint side and the end point of the whole affair. Until the siege of De Witt he insisted on working through the assembly and the courts, and only after the siege began did he agree to raise an armed force. After the battle of Crooked River, Governor Boggs issued the order of 27 October declaring that the Mormons must be treated as enemies and must be expelled or destroyed if necessary for the public peace, and only then did the people at Far West decide that further resistance was useless. On 1 November Colonel Hinkle was sent out to negotiate and returned with terms that were wholly one-sided: the leaders were to be given up for trial, all arms surrendered, every man who had taken up arms to sell his property to make good the damage done to Missouri property and to pay the cost of mustering the militia, and every man who had taken up arms to leave the state. Smith is said to have answered that he did not care, since he would have been glad to be out of the state in any case, and the next morning he and the other leaders rode out with the militia to surrender at Far West. He was held in Liberty Jail on charges of treason, murder, arson, burglary, robbery and larceny, and escaped in the spring of 1839 while being transferred, afterwards establishing Nauvoo in Illinois. Hyrum Smith, Sidney Rigdon, Lyman Wight, Caleb Baldwin and Alexander McRae were held with him, several of them later founding their own churches in Illinois and Iowa. The key figure on the Missouri side was Governor Lilburn Boggs, who had been lieutenant governor and had stood with the mob when Jackson county was cleared of the Mormons in 1833; once in office he was even more hostile, issued the expulsion order and mustered twenty-five hundred state militia. Doniphan was the only man who refused the execution order: when the court martial directed that Smith and the others be shot in the public square at Far West at nine the next morning, he called it cold-blooded murder, refused the order, and said that if it was carried out he would hold the officer responsible. Samuel Bogart led the militia that did the direct work; he was authorised by General Atchison to patrol the strip of open country between Ray and Caldwell counties, but crossed into Caldwell and began disarming the Mormons, which turned a political quarrel into an armed confrontation. The column that attacked at Haun's Mill was led by Lieutenant-Colonel Thomas Jennings of Livingston county.
kits: 火繩槍在這場衝突裡沒有序列地位，它是遺產。真正上手的武器有兩類：州民兵與後期聖徒都大量使用燧發步槍與獵槍，後期聖徒這邊尤其依賴自帶的獵槍與自遠西部運來的步槍，聯邦軍械庫的舊步槍也經民兵系統流入民間；州方的步槍多為民兵編制內的制式燧發槍，另有獵槍與少量手槍。火繩槍的存在方式很特別：密蘇里西北部是美國最早期拓殖區之一，農莊與木屋裡仍留著十八世紀末以來流傳下來的火繩槍，這種舊槍在邊境地區有時被改膛成為更重的獵槍，重量大、裝填慢，近距離仍有殺傷力，也有人直接把它當成守家的家伙；然而兩陣營都不會把這種槍配給作戰單位，它只屬於私人武裝的層次。真正在戰場上起作用的是砲：密蘇里州民兵擁有數量可觀的野砲與攻城砲，砲兵在遠西部受降時被解除了武裝，這說明州方把砲視為制亂的核心手段；反過來，後期聖徒的民兵在沒有砲的野外地區，正是靠步槍與獵槍的齊射才把州民兵逐散。此外，騎兵與車隊是這場衝突的關鍵：雙方都靠民兵騎兵在鄉間公路上搜索、封鎖與追擊，遠西部的教會成員以自備的牛車搬遷，冬季結冰的密西西比河則在一八三九年二月成為大批流離者南下的通道。
kitsEn: The matchlock has no place in the order of battle in this conflict: it is a legacy. The weapons actually in use were of two kinds, and both sides employed flintlock muskets and hunting rifles in quantity. The Latter-day Saints depended above all on the hunting rifles they had brought with them and on muskets carried in from Far West, while old muskets from federal arsenals reached private hands through the militia system; the Missouri side used standard flintlock muskets in militia service, with hunting rifles and a few pistols besides. The matchlock survives in a peculiar way. The north-west of Missouri was among the earliest settled districts of the United States, and the farmsteads and log cabins still hold matchlock muskets handed down from the late eighteenth century. In the border country such old guns were sometimes rebored into heavier hunting rifles: heavy, slow to load, still lethal at close range, and used simply as the household's own weapon. Neither side ever issued a matchlock to a fighting unit; it belonged to the level of private arms. What mattered on the field was the artillery. The Missouri militia held a considerable number of field and siege pieces, and the guns were disarmed when Far West surrendered, which shows how the state regarded artillery as the core means of restoring order. By the same token, the Mormon militia, fighting in country where they had no guns of their own, scattered the state militia by volleys of musket and rifle fire alone. Cavalry and wagons were the other pivot of the conflict: both sides used mounted militia to search, seal and pursue along the country roads, the church members at Far West moved their households on their own ox carts, and the frozen Mississippi became the route by which thousands of the disposessed travelled south in February 1839.
tactics: 這場衝突的戰術是典型的邊疆群眾暴力，不是一場有計畫的戰爭。州方的做法分三步：第一步是騷擾與包圍，暴民與治安團體先在村莊與教會之間切斷往來，封住德威特，把聚居點裡的人逼到只能決定投降或武裝自衛；第二步是解除武裝，巡邏民兵在縣界一線逐村繳械，遇到抵抗就改用武力，例如塞繆爾·博加特的隊伍越過雷郡與卡爾郡的邊界直接進入卡爾郡解除莫門人的槍械，把衝突從政治鬥爭變成武裝對峙；第三步是驅逐與掃蕩，博格斯州長集結州民兵、發出驅逐令、派人攻入郡界村莊，州議會隨後另行授權州長與民兵行使非常權力。後期聖徒這邊的戰術是自發的：第一，在教區內組織民兵、以村莊為堡壘、用步槍與獵槍的齊射對付人數與配備都更好的州民兵；第二，組建但以理派這支不聽教會領袖調度的武裝，在克羅克德河之役後乘勝追擊越界的密蘇里民兵，這支追擊隊是這場戰爭中戰術最完整的一支，卻也是把教會拖向深淵的一步；第三，在大軍壓境時放棄抵抗、由辛克爾出面談判、以交出人與武器換取全體離境。摩門民兵在哈恩磨坊的表現說明了他們的極限：他們退入鐵匠鋪當作臨時堡壘，但木屋的縫隙太大，進攻方的火槍可以直接從縫裡射入，防守方沒有砲可以反制，也沒有足以壓制對方火力的地形。最後的結果則是純粹的追捕與非戰鬥損失：遠西部投降後，州兵在城中搜查武器、沒收物資，教會成員大批南遷，戰鬥本身在十一月初就結束了。
tacticsEn: The method on both sides was that of frontier popular violence, not of a planned war. The state proceeded in three stages. First harassment and encirclement: the mobs and the vigilance companies cut the roads between the villages and the church, sealed up De Witt, and forced the people gathered there to choose between surrender and taking up arms. Second, disarmament: patrolling militia went along the county line village by village taking weapons, and where they met resistance they used force, as when Samuel Bogart's column crossed from Ray into Carroll and began disarming the Mormons, which turned a political quarrel into an armed confrontation. Third, expulsion and sweep: Governor Boggs mustered the state militia, issued the order, sent columns into the villages of the border counties, and the state legislature then authorised the governor and the militia to exercise extraordinary powers. The Latter-day Saint method was spontaneous. First, the organisation of militia by district, the village as strongpoint, and volleys of musket and rifle fire against a state militia that was larger and better equipped. Second, the raising of the Danites, an armed body that would not take orders from the church leadership and which pursued the Missouri men across the county line after Crooked River; that pursuing column was tactically the most complete formation of the war, and it was also the step that dragged the church down. Third, when the columns closed in, the decision to stop resisting, to send Hinkle out to negotiate, and to give up men and weapons in exchange for the withdrawal of the whole community. The conduct of the Mormon defenders at Haun's Mill shows the limit of their means: they took refuge in the blacksmith's shop as a makeshift fort, but the gaps between the logs were too wide, the attackers' muskets could shoot straight through them, and the defenders had no artillery of their own and no ground on which they could answer the fire with anything heavier. The end was pure pursuit and loss by other means: after the surrender at Far West the state troops searched the town for weapons, took property, and the church members moved south in bulk; the fighting itself was over by the beginning of November.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間跨度：從一八三八年八月六日加拉丁選舉日的鬥毆開始，到十一月一日遠西部投降、十一月下旬民兵解散為止。八月十日的克羅克德河之戰：莫門方面出動約二百人，分成三縱隊，由大衛·帕滕、查爾斯·里奇與詹姆斯·德皮率領；結果是莫門方面陣亡一人（吉迪恩·卡特）、九人受傷，其中帕滕不久後傷重而死，民兵方面陣亡一人（摩西·羅蘭）。德威特圍城在九月；十月二十七日州長博格斯發出驅逐令，並集結兩千五百名州民兵。哈恩磨坊一役在十月二十九日集結、三十日交火：一支約二百五十人的民兵縱隊進入卡德威爾郡，莫門方面死亡十七人，其中多人是在鐵匠鋪內被火槍射中；民兵方面的傷亡沒有留下可靠記錄。遠西部受降在十一月一日：民兵解除了遠西部民兵與但以理派武裝的武器；當晚的軍事法庭判令由多尼芬准將在次日執行，遭拒絕；約六十名被告被移交給里士滿由奧斯廷·金法官主持的民事調查法庭，審訊於十一月十二日開始；約瑟·斯密、希律·斯密、賽德尼·里格登、萊曼·懷特、卡萊布·鮑德溫與亞歷山大·麥克雷六人被以叛國等罪名收押於自由監獄。整場衝突的傷亡總計：州方一人陣亡，約一百人被迫離家；莫門方面二十一人陣亡（其中十七人在哈恩磨坊），約一萬人被迫離境。遠西部投降的條件包括：交出首領受審、交出全部武器、凡參與武裝者變賣財產賠償民眾損失並負擔民兵召集費用、凡參與武裝者一律離州。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time the conflict ran from the brawl at the Gallatin election on 6 August 1838 to the surrender at Far West on 1 November and the disbanding of the militia late in that month. At the battle of Crooked River on 10 August, the Mormons brought about two hundred men in three columns led by David Patten, Charles Rich and James Durphee; on their side one man was killed, Gideon Carter, and nine wounded, Patten among them, dying of his wounds soon after, while the militia lost one man, Moses Rowland. The siege of De Witt belongs to September; on 27 October Governor Boggs issued the expulsion order and mustered two thousand five hundred state militia. The column for Haun's Mill assembled on 29 October and fought on the 30th: a band of about two hundred and fifty militia entered Caldwell county, and seventeen Mormons were killed, several of them shot inside the blacksmith's shop; no reliable figure survives for militia casualties. The surrender at Far West came on 1 November: the militia took the weapons of the Far West militia and of the Danite bands; the court martial that evening ordered Doniphan to carry out the sentence the next day, and he refused; some sixty defendants were handed over to a civil court of inquiry at Richmond under Judge Austin A. King, which opened on 12 November; six leaders, Joseph Smith, Hyrum Smith, Sidney Rigdon, Lyman Wight, Caleb Baldwin and Alexander McRae, were held in Liberty Jail on charges including treason. Casualties for the conflict as a whole: on the Missouri side one man killed and about a hundred people displaced; on the Mormon side twenty-one killed, seventeen of them at Haun's Mill, and about ten thousand people driven out of the state. The terms of the surrender at Far West were: to give up the leaders for trial, to surrender all arms, for every man who had taken up arms to sell his property in payment of the damage done to Missouri property and of the cost of mustering the militia, and for every man who had taken up arms to leave the state.
cause: 起事的原因是幾個月的衝突，但它背後的結構問題更深。直接導火線是土地與選舉：摩門教會自一八三一年起依聚集教義遷入密蘇里州，一八三三年被傑克遜縣的暴民暴力逐出，一八三六年州議會設立卡德威爾郡，本意是把他們限制在一處，卻沒有解決爭端；一八三七年俄亥俄的基爾特蘭教會總部崩潰之後，大批教會成員西遷進入密蘇里，密蘇里的居民覺得自己的土地、教會選票與政治影響力正被一個外部集團奪走。一八三八年八月六日，加拉丁鎮的投票日上，一群人擋住摩門人投票，雙方在投票箱前互毆，這場街頭衝突被兩邊同時放大：摩門人認為是政治歧視，州內居民則認為是一次武裝叛變的開始。州長博格斯在任副州長時，一八三三年傑克遜縣的驅逐中他站在暴民一方，因此從一開始就把教會視為敵人；他的處置方式不是司法而是軍令，最終釀成驅逐令與民兵圍攻。教堂與教區在這裡的關鍵角色是組織：教會把分散的移民變成有紀律、有共同信仰的團體，這既是它在選票上勝出的原因，也是它被視為威脅的原因。深層的結構性因素則是美國西部拓殖的資源分配：新遷入者與本地農民爭奪土地、水源與教會位置，而教會握有集中的資產、互助的網絡與跨州的政治影響力，兩種力量在同一片土地上相遇，最後都以暴力收場。
causeEn: The outbreak was a clash of a few months, but the structure behind it was much deeper. The immediate trigger was land and the vote. The church had settled in Missouri from 1831 in obedience to the doctrine of gathering, was driven out of Jackson county by mob violence in 1833, and in 1836 the state legislature created Caldwell county in the intention of confining them in one place, which settled nothing. When the Kirtland headquarters in Ohio collapsed in 1837, a wave of church members moved west into Missouri, and the people of the state began to feel that their land, their church parishes and their political weight were being taken over by an outside group. On 6 August 1838, on polling day at Gallatin, a crowd blocked the Mormons from voting and the two sides fell on each other in front of the ballot box, and the street brawl was enlarged on both sides at once: to the Mormons it was political exclusion, to the inhabitants of the state it was the opening of an armed insurrection. Boggs had been lieutenant governor and had stood with the mob in the clearing of Jackson county in 1833, so from the outset he treated the church as an enemy; his response was military rather than judicial, and it ended in an expulsion order and a militia siege. The decisive role of the church and of the parish here was organisational. The church turned scattered immigrants into a disciplined body with a common faith, and that was at once the reason it could win at the polls and the reason it was treated as a threat. The deeper structural factor was the distribution of resources in the American frontier. Newcomers and established farmers competed for land, water and parish position, while the church held concentrated assets, a network of mutual aid and political influence reaching across state lines; two such forces met on the same ground, and the meeting ended in violence.
impact: 這場衝突的結果是教會被連根拔起並在伊利諾伊重新落地。教會成員自一八三八年底起陸續南遷，並於一八三九年二月在結冰的密西西比河上完成大規模渡河，抵達伊利諾伊州，在密西西比河畔建立納伏，隨後又有大批人遷往愛荷華；教會的總部因此落在美國西部的新州份，摩門戰爭的傷痕一直延續到二十世紀，這個教派至今仍是美國政治中一股獨特的力量。法律與制度的影響同樣深遠：驅逐令直到一九七六年才由密蘇里州州長正式撤銷，全州各郡的年度遊行中保留了一段為這段歷史致歉的儀式，說明這件事在州記憶中的份量；聯邦與州的關係也從中調整，利文沃思堡的通信顯示聯邦一度準備介入，也說明西部各州在內部秩序問題上長期保留軍權的傳統。教會自身的教訓同樣具體：教會把武裝組織與政治行動混為一談、讓但以理派不受領袖調度的武裝追擊越界民兵、並在最後放棄抵抗而換取撤離，三者共同構成了一八三八年這一課的內容，此後教會在政治上轉向溫和，在西部各州建立了穩定的政教結構。此外，一八三八年之後的邊境暴力模式——常備民兵、常設郡級武裝與教會武裝的對峙——成為美國西部一八四〇至一八六〇年代多次衝突的重複套路。
impactEn: The result of the conflict was that the church was torn up by the roots and replanted in Illinois. Its members moved south from the end of 1838, and in February 1839 completed a mass crossing of the frozen Mississippi, reaching Illinois and establishing Nauvoo on the banks of the river; large numbers then moved on to Iowa, and the headquarters of the church ended up in a new state in the American west. The wounds of the Mormon war were carried into the twentieth century, and the church remains a distinct force in American politics. The legal and institutional consequences were just as deep. The expulsion order was not formally rescinded by the governor of Missouri until 1976, and the annual marches in the counties of the state still include a passage atoning for that part of the state's history, which says a good deal about the weight the affair carries in Missouri memory. The relations between the federal government and the state were adjusted by it as well: the correspondence from Fort Leavenworth showed that the federal government was at one point preparing to intervene, which bears out the standing tradition in the western states of reserving military power for questions of internal order. The lessons the church drew were equally concrete. Mixing armed organisation with political action, allowing a body of armed men that would not take orders from the leadership to pursue militia across the county line, and finally giving up resistance in exchange for withdrawal: the three together made up the content of the lesson of 1838, and after it the church turned moderate in politics and built a stable church-and-state structure in the western states. The pattern of frontier violence that 1838 established, a stand-off between standing militia, county levies and church arms, was repeated in a series of clashes across the American west between the 1840s and the 1860s.
result: 結果是教會在武力上被壓碎，在遷徙上被改寫。十一月一日，遠西部民兵被解除了武裝，斯密與其他首領隨軍到營地後被捕；當晚的軍事法庭判令由多尼芬准將在次日執行槍決，多尼芬當場拒絕，稱之為冷血謀殺，並以自己的旅次日開往自由監獄相抗。約六十名被告於十一月十二日起在里士滿由奧斯廷·金法官主持的民事調查法庭受審，六名首領——約瑟·斯密、希律·斯密、賽德尼·里格登、萊曼·懷特、卡萊布·鮑德溫與亞歷山大·麥克雷——以叛國等罪名被收押於自由監獄。州方在此役的代價極小：民兵方面一人陣亡，約一百人被迫離家；摩門方面二十一人陣亡，其中十七人在哈恩磨坊，約一萬人被迫離州。十一月一日之後州民兵解散，遠西部在次年春天清空，教會成員南遷，於一八三九年二月在結冰的密西西比河上完成大規模渡河，抵達伊利諾伊州並在河畔建立納伏；斯密本人在一八三九年四月轉移途中逃出監獄。軍事上這場衝突以清剿收場，政治上卻留下兩項長尾：密蘇里州直到一九七六年才撤銷驅逐令，而教會則在伊利諾伊重新建立，在一八四六年組織的摩門兵團，成為美國西部拓殖史上的一支特殊隊伍。
resultEn: The result was that the church was crushed as a military force and remade by its migration. On 1 November the militia at Far West were disarmed, and Smith and the other leaders rode out to the camp and were arrested. The court martial that evening ordered Doniphan to carry out the firing squad the next morning; Doniphan refused on the spot, called it cold-blooded murder, and announced that his brigade would march for Liberty the next morning and that he would hold the officer responsible. Some sixty defendants were tried from 12 November by a civil court of inquiry at Richmond under Judge Austin A. King, and six leaders, Joseph Smith, Hyrum Smith, Sidney Rigdon, Lyman Wight, Caleb Baldwin and Alexander McRae, were held in Liberty Jail on charges including treason. The cost to Missouri was small: one militiaman killed and about a hundred people displaced. On the other side twenty-one were killed, seventeen of them at Haun's Mill, and about ten thousand people were driven out of the state. The state militia was disbanded after 1 November, Far West was emptied by the spring, and the church members moved south, completing the mass crossing of the frozen Mississippi in February 1839 and founding Nauvoo on the river in Illinois; Smith himself escaped from jail in April 1839 while being transferred. Militarily the conflict ended in a round of clearances, but politically it left two long tails: Missouri did not rescind the expulsion order until 1976, and the church, re-founded in Illinois, raised the Mormon Battalion of 1846, a formation without parallel in the history of western American settlement.
